ar: الحجر
en: Sura 15: Al-Hijr

p.src: 15:1  Alif Lām Ra[1]. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’an.

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: Alif Lām Ra[1]. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’an.
u.src: 15:1  Alif Lām Ra[1]. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’an.

en: [1] See footnote 2:1.

p.src: 15:2  The disbelievers will soon[2] wish that they were Muslims.

ar: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
en: The disbelievers will soon[2] wish that they were Muslims.
u.src: 15:2  The disbelievers will soon[2] wish that they were Muslims.

en: [2] On the Judgment Day or upon their death.

p.src: 15:3  Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted with false hope; they will come to know.

ar: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted with false hope; they will come to know.
u.src: 15:3  Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted with false hope; they will come to know.

p.src: 15:4  We never destroyed any town except that it had a destined time.

ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
en: We never destroyed any town except that it had a destined time.
u.src: 15:4  We never destroyed any town except that it had a destined time.

p.src: 15:5  No nation can advance its appointed time, nor can they delay it.

ar: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
en: No nation can advance its appointed time, nor can they delay it.
u.src: 15:5  No nation can advance its appointed time, nor can they delay it.

p.src: 15:6  They say, “O you to whom the Reminder has been sent down, You are surely insane[3]!

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
en: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder has been sent down, You are surely insane[3]!
u.src: 15:6  They say, “O you to whom the Reminder has been sent down, You are surely insane[3]!

en: [3] These deriding remarks were very hard on the Prophet (ﷺ), and Allah consoles him in this surah.

p.src: 15:7  Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are truthful?”

ar: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
en: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are truthful?”
u.src: 15:7  Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are truthful?”

p.src: 15:8  We do not send down the angels except for a just cause, and then [the disbelievers] would be granted no respite[4].

ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
en: We do not send down the angels except for a just cause, and then [the disbelievers] would be granted no respite[4].
u.src: 15:8  We do not send down the angels except for a just cause, and then [the disbelievers] would be granted no respite[4].

en: [4] i.e., then they would be destroyed on the spot.

p.src: 15:9  It is We Who have sent down the Reminder[5], and it is We Who will preserve it[6].

ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
en: It is We Who have sent down the Reminder[5], and it is We Who will preserve it[6].
u.src: 15:9  It is We Who have sent down the Reminder[5], and it is We Who will preserve it[6].

en:
[5] As a reminder for people.
 [6] From distortion, alteration, addition, and omission. More than 1400 years have elapsed and not a single word of this Qur’an has been changed, although enemies have tried their utmost.

p.src: 15:10  We did send messengers before you among the factions of early peoples.

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: We did send messengers before you among the factions of early peoples.
u.src: 15:10  We did send messengers before you among the factions of early peoples.

p.src: 15:11  No messenger came to them except that they ridiculed him.

ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: No messenger came to them except that they ridiculed him.
u.src: 15:11  No messenger came to them except that they ridiculed him.

p.src: 15:12  This is how We let this [denial] enter the hearts of the wicked[7].

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
en: This is how We let this [denial] enter the hearts of the wicked[7].
u.src: 15:12  This is how We let this [denial] enter the hearts of the wicked[7].

en: [7] For they rebelled against the Truth and did not submit to it.

p.src: 15:13  They will not believe in it, although the examples of the earlier people are well established.

ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: They will not believe in it, although the examples of the earlier people are well established.
u.src: 15:13  They will not believe in it, although the examples of the earlier people are well established.

p.src: 15:14  Even if We were to open for them a gateway to the heaven, through which they kept ascending,

ar: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
en: Even if We were to open for them a gateway to the heaven, through which they kept ascending,
u.src: 15:14  Even if We were to open for them a gateway to the heaven, through which they kept ascending,

p.src: 15:15  they would still say, “Our eyes have been dazzled; rather, we have been bewitched.”

ar: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
en: they would still say, “Our eyes have been dazzled; rather, we have been bewitched.”
u.src: 15:15  they would still say, “Our eyes have been dazzled; rather, we have been bewitched.”

p.src: 15:16  We have placed constellations in the heaven and adorned it for the onlookers,

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
en: We have placed constellations in the heaven and adorned it for the onlookers,
u.src: 15:16  We have placed constellations in the heaven and adorned it for the onlookers,

p.src: 15:17  and We have guarded it from every accursed devil,

ar: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
en: and We have guarded it from every accursed devil,
u.src: 15:17  and We have guarded it from every accursed devil,

p.src: 15:18  except the one who manages to eavesdrop, he will then be pursued by a visible burning flame.

ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: except the one who manages to eavesdrop, he will then be pursued by a visible burning flame.
u.src: 15:18  except the one who manages to eavesdrop, he will then be pursued by a visible burning flame.

p.src: 15:19  As for the earth, We have spread it out and placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein everything in due proportion.

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
en: As for the earth, We have spread it out and placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein everything in due proportion.
u.src: 15:19  As for the earth, We have spread it out and placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein everything in due proportion.

p.src: 15:20  And We have made therein for you means of sustenance and for those[8] whom you do not provide.

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
en: And We have made therein for you means of sustenance and for those[8] whom you do not provide.
u.src: 15:20  And We have made therein for you means of sustenance and for those[8] whom you do not provide.

en: [8] i.e., the children, servants, and livestock that one is blessed with.

p.src: 15:21  There is nothing except that We have its treasuries, and We do not send it down except in a determined measure.

ar: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
en: There is nothing except that We have its treasuries, and We do not send it down except in a determined measure.
u.src: 15:21  There is nothing except that We have its treasuries, and We do not send it down except in a determined measure.

p.src: 15:22  And We send fertilizing winds[9], and send down rain from the sky for you to drink, and it is not you who could store it.

ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ
en: And We send fertilizing winds[9], and send down rain from the sky for you to drink, and it is not you who could store it.
u.src: 15:22  And We send fertilizing winds[9], and send down rain from the sky for you to drink, and it is not you who could store it.

en: [9] Causing precipitation in rainclouds or carrying pollen.

p.src: 15:23  Indeed, it is We Who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors [of all things].

ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
en: Indeed, it is We Who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors [of all things].
u.src: 15:23  Indeed, it is We Who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors [of all things].

p.src: 15:24  We surely know those of you who have gone before and those who are yet to come.

ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
en: We surely know those of you who have gone before and those who are yet to come.
u.src: 15:24  We surely know those of you who have gone before and those who are yet to come.

p.src: 15:25  It is your Lord Who will gather them together. He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
en: It is your Lord Who will gather them together. He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
u.src: 15:25  It is your Lord Who will gather them together. He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.

p.src: 15:26  We have created man from sounding clay, made of aging mud[10].

ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
en: We have created man from sounding clay, made of aging mud[10].
u.src: 15:26  We have created man from sounding clay, made of aging mud[10].

en: [10] Salsāl: clay left to ferment and turn hard so that it clinks when tapped on. Hama’: transformed or blackened clay. Masnūn: the smell of which has turned foul or left for some time.

p.src: 15:27  And the jinn[11] We created before that, from smokeless fire.

ar: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
en: And the jinn[11] We created before that, from smokeless fire.
u.src: 15:27  And the jinn[11] We created before that, from smokeless fire.

en: [11] The jinn: They are the creatures of Allah, who are different from humans. There are some among them who are righteous, while others are wicked. They are not humans or a species of humans.

p.src: 15:28  And [remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay, made of aging mud.

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
en: And [remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay, made of aging mud.
u.src: 15:28  And [remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay, made of aging mud.

p.src: 15:29  When I have shaped him and breathed into him of My spirit[12], then fall down before him in prostration.”

ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
en: When I have shaped him and breathed into him of My spirit[12], then fall down before him in prostration.”
u.src: 15:29  When I have shaped him and breathed into him of My spirit[12], then fall down before him in prostration.”

en: [12] The spirit which Allah created for that body, not His own Spirit (as some mistakenly believe). Allah attributed it to Himself as a sign of honoring him, as in nāqat Allah (the she-camel of Allah).

p.src: 15:30  Thereupon, all of the angels fell down in prostration,

ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
en: Thereupon, all of the angels fell down in prostration,
u.src: 15:30  Thereupon, all of the angels fell down in prostration,

p.src: 15:31  except for Iblīs, who refused to be with those who prostrated[13].

ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
en: except for Iblīs, who refused to be with those who prostrated[13].
u.src: 15:31  except for Iblīs, who refused to be with those who prostrated[13].

p.src: 15:32  Allah said, “O Iblīs, what is the matter with you that you were not with those who prostrated?”

ar: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
en: Allah said, “O Iblīs, what is the matter with you that you were not with those who prostrated?”
u.src: 15:32  Allah said, “O Iblīs, what is the matter with you that you were not with those who prostrated?”

p.src: 15:33  He said, “I am not such to prostrate before a human whom You created from sounding clay, made of aging mud.[14]”

ar: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
en: He said, “I am not such to prostrate before a human whom You created from sounding clay, made of aging mud.[14]”
u.src: 15:33  He said, “I am not such to prostrate before a human whom You created from sounding clay, made of aging mud.[14]”

en: [14] He said: “I am better than him; You created me from fire and created him from clay.” See 7:12.

p.src: 15:34  He said, “Then get out of here[15], for you are accursed,

ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
en: He said, “Then get out of here[15], for you are accursed,
u.src: 15:34  He said, “Then get out of here[15], for you are accursed,

en: [15] i.e., from the heaven.

p.src: 15:35  and the curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”

ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
en: and the curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”
u.src: 15:35  and the curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”

p.src: 15:36  Iblīs said, “My Lord, then grant me respite until the Day they are resurrected.”

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
en: Iblīs said, “My Lord, then grant me respite until the Day they are resurrected.”
u.src: 15:36  Iblīs said, “My Lord, then grant me respite until the Day they are resurrected.”

p.src: 15:37  Allah said, “You are of those who are granted respite[16],

ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
en: Allah said, “You are of those who are granted respite[16],
u.src: 15:37  Allah said, “You are of those who are granted respite[16],

en: [16] As a trial; to sift out His obedient servants from those who obey Iblīs.

p.src: 15:38  until the Day of the Appointed Time[17].”

ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
en: until the Day of the Appointed Time[17].”
u.src: 15:38  until the Day of the Appointed Time[17].”

en: [17] i.e., the Day of Judgment.

p.src: 15:39  He said, “My Lord, since You have sent me astray[18], I will surely make [sins] alluring to them on earth and mislead them all,

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: He said, “My Lord, since You have sent me astray[18], I will surely make [sins] alluring to them on earth and mislead them all,
u.src: 15:39  He said, “My Lord, since You have sent me astray[18], I will surely make [sins] alluring to them on earth and mislead them all,

en: [18] Satan set the record for being the first to use predestination (al-qadar) as a pretext for disobeying Allah’s command (al-’amr).

p.src: 15:40  except for Your chosen slaves among them.”

ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
en: except for Your chosen slaves among them.”
u.src: 15:40  except for Your chosen slaves among them.”

p.src: 15:41  Allah said, “This is a straight path leading to Me.

ar: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
en: Allah said, “This is a straight path leading to Me.
u.src: 15:41  Allah said, “This is a straight path leading to Me.

p.src: 15:42  You will have no authority over My slaves, except the deviants who follow you.

ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
en: You will have no authority over My slaves, except the deviants who follow you.
u.src: 15:42  You will have no authority over My slaves, except the deviants who follow you.

p.src: 15:43  And Hell is certainly the promised place for them, all together.

ar: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: And Hell is certainly the promised place for them, all together.
u.src: 15:43  And Hell is certainly the promised place for them, all together.

p.src: 15:44  It has seven gates[19]; each gate will have its allotted share of them.”

ar: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
en: It has seven gates[19]; each gate will have its allotted share of them.”
u.src: 15:44  It has seven gates[19]; each gate will have its allotted share of them.”

en: [19] The doors of Hell are plenty; according to the crime.

p.src: 15:45  The righteous will be in gardens and springs.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
en: The righteous will be in gardens and springs.
u.src: 15:45  The righteous will be in gardens and springs.

p.src: 15:46  “Enter in peace and safety[20]!”

ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
en: “Enter in peace and safety[20]!”
u.src: 15:46  “Enter in peace and safety[20]!”

en: [20] i.e., safe from all ills, troubles, and all that might put a dent in their happiness.

p.src: 15:47  We will remove all ill feelings from their hearts[21]; like brothers, seated on couches facing one another.

ar: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
en: We will remove all ill feelings from their hearts[21]; like brothers, seated on couches facing one another.
u.src: 15:47  We will remove all ill feelings from their hearts[21]; like brothers, seated on couches facing one another.

en: [21] This is in perfection of their bliss, by having no ill-will whatsoever.

p.src: 15:48  No fatigue will ever touch them therein[22], nor will they ever be made to leave.

ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
en: No fatigue will ever touch them therein[22], nor will they ever be made to leave.
u.src: 15:48  No fatigue will ever touch them therein[22], nor will they ever be made to leave.

en: [22] i.e., untainted by drawbacks of toil or uneasiness about the future.

p.src: 15:49  Inform My slaves that I am indeed the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful,

ar: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: Inform My slaves that I am indeed the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful,
u.src: 15:49  Inform My slaves that I am indeed the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful,

p.src: 15:50  and that My punishment is the most painful punishment.

ar: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
en: and that My punishment is the most painful punishment.
u.src: 15:50  and that My punishment is the most painful punishment.

p.src: 15:51  And inform them about the guests of Abraham.

ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
en: And inform them about the guests of Abraham.
u.src: 15:51  And inform them about the guests of Abraham.

p.src: 15:52  When they entered upon him and said, “Peace!” He said, “We are afraid of you[23].”

ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
en: When they entered upon him and said, “Peace!” He said, “We are afraid of you[23].”
u.src: 15:52  When they entered upon him and said, “Peace!” He said, “We are afraid of you[23].”

en: [23] When he saw that their hands did not reach the roasted calf he presented to them.

p.src: 15:53  They said, “Do not be afraid; We give you glad tidings of a knowledgeable boy[24].”

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
en: They said, “Do not be afraid; We give you glad tidings of a knowledgeable boy[24].”
u.src: 15:53  They said, “Do not be afraid; We give you glad tidings of a knowledgeable boy[24].”

en: [24] i.e., Isaac; of great religious knowledge.

p.src: 15:54  He said, “Do you give me glad tidings despite my old age? What glad tidings are you giving me?”

ar: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
en: He said, “Do you give me glad tidings despite my old age? What glad tidings are you giving me?”
u.src: 15:54  He said, “Do you give me glad tidings despite my old age? What glad tidings are you giving me?”

p.src: 15:55  They said, “We have given you glad tidings in truth, so do not be of those who despair[25].”

ar: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ
en: They said, “We have given you glad tidings in truth, so do not be of those who despair[25].”
u.src: 15:55  They said, “We have given you glad tidings in truth, so do not be of those who despair[25].”

en: [25] Abraham (عليه السلام) might have shown signs of doubt at believing such news.

p.src: 15:56  He said, “Who would despair of his Lord’s mercy except those who are misguided[26]?”

ar: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
en: He said, “Who would despair of his Lord’s mercy except those who are misguided[26]?”
u.src: 15:56  He said, “Who would despair of his Lord’s mercy except those who are misguided[26]?”

en: [26] Abraham’s (عليه السلام) reply disproves the assumption that he was despondent of Allah’s Mercy.

p.src: 15:57  He said, “So, what is your mission, O messengers?”

ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
en: He said, “So, what is your mission, O messengers?”
u.src: 15:57  He said, “So, what is your mission, O messengers?”

p.src: 15:58  They said, “We have been sent to a wicked people[27],

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
en: They said, “We have been sent to a wicked people[27],
u.src: 15:58  They said, “We have been sent to a wicked people[27],

en: [27] i.e., the people of the prophet Lot (عليه السلام).

p.src: 15:59  except the household of Lot; we will surely save them all,

ar: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: except the household of Lot; we will surely save them all,
u.src: 15:59  except the household of Lot; we will surely save them all,

p.src: 15:60  except his wife[28]; We have decreed that she will be among those who stay behind.”

ar: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
en: except his wife[28]; We have decreed that she will be among those who stay behind.”
u.src: 15:60  except his wife[28]; We have decreed that she will be among those who stay behind.”

en: [28] For she has collaborated with the evildoers.

p.src: 15:61  When the messengers came to the household of Lot[29],

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
en: When the messengers came to the household of Lot[29],
u.src: 15:61  When the messengers came to the household of Lot[29],

en: [29] Details of the first three nations destroyed are given in this and the following verses, which were en route of the famous trading journeys of the Qurayshites: the people of Prophet Lot, those of the thicket (the people of Shu‘ayb), and those of Hegra (Madā’in Sālih).

p.src: 15:62  he said, “You are unfamiliar people.”

ar: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
en: he said, “You are unfamiliar people.”
u.src: 15:62  he said, “You are unfamiliar people.”

p.src: 15:63  They said, “We have come to you with that [punishment][30] which they have doubted.

ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
en: They said, “We have come to you with that [punishment][30] which they have doubted.
u.src: 15:63  They said, “We have come to you with that [punishment][30] which they have doubted.

en: [30] i.e., the divine punishment.

p.src: 15:64  We have come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful.

ar: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
en: We have come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful.
u.src: 15:64  We have come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful.

p.src: 15:65  So travel with your household in the dark of night and go behind them; none of you should look back[31], and keep going to where you are commanded.”

ar: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
en: So travel with your household in the dark of night and go behind them; none of you should look back[31], and keep going to where you are commanded.”
u.src: 15:65  So travel with your household in the dark of night and go behind them; none of you should look back[31], and keep going to where you are commanded.”

en: [31] To be more persistent in their walk and strike some distance before dawn, or not to be frightened and traumatized by catching sight of the horrific punishment of their folks.

p.src: 15:66  We conveyed this decree to him that these [people] will be exterminated by early morning.”

ar: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
en: We conveyed this decree to him that these [people] will be exterminated by early morning.”
u.src: 15:66  We conveyed this decree to him that these [people] will be exterminated by early morning.”

p.src: 15:67  The people of the city came [to Lot] rejoicing[32].

ar: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
en: The people of the city came [to Lot] rejoicing[32].
u.src: 15:67  The people of the city came [to Lot] rejoicing[32].

en: [32] At the news of his visitors.

p.src: 15:68  Lot said, “These are my guests, so do not bring shame on me.

ar: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
en: Lot said, “These are my guests, so do not bring shame on me.
u.src: 15:68  Lot said, “These are my guests, so do not bring shame on me.

p.src: 15:69  Fear Allah and do not disgrace me.”

ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
en: Fear Allah and do not disgrace me.”
u.src: 15:69  Fear Allah and do not disgrace me.”

p.src: 15:70  They said, “Did we not forbid you from [protecting] people?”

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
en: They said, “Did we not forbid you from [protecting] people?”
u.src: 15:70  They said, “Did we not forbid you from [protecting] people?”

p.src: 15:71  He said, “These are my daughters [to marry], if you must[33].”

ar: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
en: He said, “These are my daughters [to marry], if you must[33].”
u.src: 15:71  He said, “These are my daughters [to marry], if you must[33].”

en: [33] i.e., the women of my community or my own daughters in a lawful marriage.

p.src: 15:72  By your life [O prophet], they were wandering blindly in their intoxication [of lust][34].

ar: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
en: By your life [O prophet], they were wandering blindly in their intoxication [of lust][34].
u.src: 15:72  By your life [O prophet], they were wandering blindly in their intoxication [of lust][34].

en: [34] Admonition is of no use, no matter how reasonable it is, when someone is drunk in their lust.

p.src: 15:73  So they were seized by the blast at sunrise,

ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
en: So they were seized by the blast at sunrise,
u.src: 15:73  So they were seized by the blast at sunrise,

p.src: 15:74  and We turned their cities upside down[35] and rained down on them stones of baked clay.

ar: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
en: and We turned their cities upside down[35] and rained down on them stones of baked clay.
u.src: 15:74  and We turned their cities upside down[35] and rained down on them stones of baked clay.

en: [35] Their nature was twisted, so their punishment was of its like.

p.src: 15:75  Indeed, there are signs in this for those who discern[36].

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
en: Indeed, there are signs in this for those who discern[36].
u.src: 15:75  Indeed, there are signs in this for those who discern[36].

en: [36] i.e., those who look deeply into signifying signs.

p.src: 15:76  And their place is located by a known route[37].

ar: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
en: And their place is located by a known route[37].
u.src: 15:76  And their place is located by a known route[37].

en: [37] i.e., on the highway to the Levant, where the Dead Sea is now.

p.src: 15:77  Indeed, there are signs in this for the believers.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: Indeed, there are signs in this for the believers.
u.src: 15:77  Indeed, there are signs in this for the believers.

p.src: 15:78  And the people of the Forest[38] were wrongdoers.

ar: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ
en: And the people of the Forest[38] were wrongdoers.
u.src: 15:78  And the people of the Forest[38] were wrongdoers.

en: [38] i.e., the people of the thicket, i.e. the people of Prophet Shu‘ayb (عليه السلام) who lived in Madian, not far from the people of Lot.

p.src: 15:79  So We punished them in retribution, and both [places][39] are by a clear highway.

ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: So We punished them in retribution, and both [places][39] are by a clear highway.
u.src: 15:79  So We punished them in retribution, and both [places][39] are by a clear highway.

en: [39] i.e., both the dwellings of the people of Prophet Lot (عليه السلام) and Prophet Shu‘ayb (عليه السلام).

p.src: 15:80  Surely the people of Al-Hijr[40] also rejected the messengers.

ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
en: Surely the people of Al-Hijr[40] also rejected the messengers.
u.src: 15:80  Surely the people of Al-Hijr[40] also rejected the messengers.

en: [40] i.e., Thamūd: the people of Prophet Sālih (عليه السلام).

p.src: 15:81  We gave them Our signs, but they kept turning away from them.

ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
en: We gave them Our signs, but they kept turning away from them.
u.src: 15:81  We gave them Our signs, but they kept turning away from them.

p.src: 15:82  They carved houses in the mountains, feeling secure[41].

ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
en: They carved houses in the mountains, feeling secure[41].
u.src: 15:82  They carved houses in the mountains, feeling secure[41].

en: [41] These mountainous strongholds gave them a false sense of security against any consequences.

p.src: 15:83  So they were seized by the blast early in the morning.

ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
en: So they were seized by the blast early in the morning.
u.src: 15:83  So they were seized by the blast early in the morning.

p.src: 15:84  Nothing of what they earned was of any avail to them.

ar: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
en: Nothing of what they earned was of any avail to them.
u.src: 15:84  Nothing of what they earned was of any avail to them.

p.src: 15:85  We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them except for a true purpose. The Hour is certainly coming, so bear with them graciously[42].

ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
en: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them except for a true purpose. The Hour is certainly coming, so bear with them graciously[42].
u.src: 15:85  We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them except for a true purpose. The Hour is certainly coming, so bear with them graciously[42].

en: [42] This final passage puts things into perspective, addressing the Prophet (ﷺ) - that all people, including those who tormented him, will be justly held accountable for their deeds, and asking him to overlook their taunts and not censure them for it.

p.src: 15:86  Indeed, your Lord is the Absolute Creator, the All-Knowing.

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: Indeed, your Lord is the Absolute Creator, the All-Knowing.
u.src: 15:86  Indeed, your Lord is the Absolute Creator, the All-Knowing.

p.src: 15:87  We have surely given you the seven oft-repeated verses[43] and the great Qur’an.

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
en: We have surely given you the seven oft-repeated verses[43] and the great Qur’an.
u.src: 15:87  We have surely given you the seven oft-repeated verses[43] and the great Qur’an.

en: [43] i.e., Seven of al-Mathāni (seven repeatedly recited verses), referring to Surat al-Fātihah.

p.src: 15:88  Do not look longingly at the pleasures We have given certain classes[44] of them[45], nor grieve over them[46], but lower your wing [in humility] to the believers[47].

ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: Do not look longingly at the pleasures We have given certain classes[44] of them[45], nor grieve over them[46], but lower your wing [in humility] to the believers[47].
u.src: 15:88  Do not look longingly at the pleasures We have given certain classes[44] of them[45], nor grieve over them[46], but lower your wing [in humility] to the believers[47].

en:
[44] Azwāj: literally means pairs; here it means those who are alike in prosperity, as not all of them were rich and prosperous. [45] So as to test them therein.
 [46] The Prophet (ﷺ) felt sad that they would not believe and save themselves from Hellfire.
 [47] The favor of the Qur’an far surpasses all other favors and worldly gains.

p.src: 15:89  And say, “I am indeed a clear warner.” –

ar: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
en: And say, “I am indeed a clear warner.” –
u.src: 15:89  And say, “I am indeed a clear warner.” –

p.src: 15:90  just as We sent down [punishment] upon those who divided [their religion][48],

ar: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
en: just as We sent down [punishment] upon those who divided [their religion][48],
u.src: 15:90  just as We sent down [punishment] upon those who divided [their religion][48],

en: [48] i.e., the People of the Book, who accepted some portions of the Torah and rejected some.

p.src: 15:91  those who split the Qur’an into different portions[49].

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
en: those who split the Qur’an into different portions[49].
u.src: 15:91  those who split the Qur’an into different portions[49].

en: [49] i.e., calling it magic, divination, or poetry.

p.src: 15:92  By your Lord, We will surely question them all

ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: By your Lord, We will surely question them all
u.src: 15:92  By your Lord, We will surely question them all

p.src: 15:93  concerning what they used to do.

ar: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: concerning what they used to do.
u.src: 15:93  concerning what they used to do.

p.src: 15:94  Then proclaim what you are commanded, and turn away from those who associate partners with Allah.

ar: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
en: Then proclaim what you are commanded, and turn away from those who associate partners with Allah.
u.src: 15:94  Then proclaim what you are commanded, and turn away from those who associate partners with Allah.

p.src: 15:95  We will surely suffice you against the mockers[50],

ar: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
en: We will surely suffice you against the mockers[50],
u.src: 15:95  We will surely suffice you against the mockers[50],

en: [50] For this command will be tough, Allah gave him assurance.

p.src: 15:96  those who set up beside Allah another god; they will come to know.

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: those who set up beside Allah another god; they will come to know.
u.src: 15:96  those who set up beside Allah another god; they will come to know.

p.src: 15:97  We know that you are distressed by what they say.

ar: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
en: We know that you are distressed by what they say.
u.src: 15:97  We know that you are distressed by what they say.

p.src: 15:98  So glorify your Lord with praise and be among those who prostrate [to Him][51],

ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
en: So glorify your Lord with praise and be among those who prostrate [to Him][51],
u.src: 15:98  So glorify your Lord with praise and be among those who prostrate [to Him][51],

en: [51] The remedy is in resorting to Allah Almighty.

p.src: 15:99  and worship your Lord until the certainty [of death] comes to you.

ar: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
en: and worship your Lord until the certainty [of death] comes to you.
u.src: 15:99  and worship your Lord until the certainty [of death] comes to you.
